sections.heading: Your tutorial gear
sections.body: After attuning your first Essence, Crafting teaches you how to make a Tier 1 one-handed weapon. You receive exactly 10 Ore and 3 Wood, enough to choose one of the available one-handed weapon styles.

sections.heading: What to do
sections.body: Select the weapon you crafted directly from your inventory, then equip it before your first expedition.

sections.heading: Next step
sections.body: Once your crafted weapon is equipped, begin an expedition in Lumo Ruins to complete First Steps and unlock normal Shenic combat.
